svg.title: PolicyC canary 3 and canary 5 arm outcomes
svg.desc: Canary 3, sixteen trials per arm: the compiler 0.10 slice passed 2 with 0 unsafe actions and 8 redundant re-asks and kept 1 of 6 full-policy passes; the clause slice passed 5 with 2 unsafe and 3 re-asks and kept 2 of 6; the full policy passed 6 with 3 unsafe and 2 re-asks and reproduced 2 of 6 of its own other sample's passes; the model reader passed 6 with 0 unsafe and 2 re-asks and kept 4 of 6. Canary 5 answer run without a reader: the compiler slice passed 4 with 0 unsafe and 8 re-asks and kept 4 of 5; the clause slice passed 4 with 0 unsafe and 7 re-asks and kept 4 of 5; the full policy passed 5 with 2 unsafe and 0 re-asks and reproduced 4 of 5 of its own; the condition list passed 3 with 0 unsafe and 4 re-asks and kept 3 of 5. Eight cases and two samples per canary; these are directions, not rates.

g.text: Which prompt did what the policy says
Eight fresh cases each, two samples, isolated author and grader, rubric locked before any output. Direction, not rate.
Canary 3: a model reads the clauses and writes directives
Canary 5: conditions listed in the answer prompt, no reader
Kept of 5 full passes; full vs. itself 4/5
Canary 5: three confirmed cases were blanked for every arm by a harness effect (lookup-first tool schemas; calls are recorded, not executed).
